Every client, every service

Every client is identity-verified before any work begins

A $99 tax return or a company setup, new client or returning — nobody is lodged, registered or advised at XYZ Accounting until they have passed an electronic identity check. It takes about three minutes on your phone, it is included in every fee, and it is how we keep your refund, your tax file number and your entities out of someone else’s hands.

How long

About three minutes

On your phone, from a link we send you. No appointment, no certified copies, no posting documents.

What it costs

Nothing extra

Included in every published fee. There is no verification surcharge on any service.

Who runs it

An accredited Australian platform

An Australian AML/CTF compliance platform built on electronic identity verification checked against government records. ISO 27001 certified.

Why we check everyone

  • It protects your refund. Tax refund fraud starts with someone lodging as you. A verified identity on every file means nobody can open a return in your name with a stolen payslip and a borrowed email address.
  • The Tax Practitioners Board requires it. Registered tax agents must verify the identity of every new client before acting for them. We do it electronically against government records rather than by looking at a photo of a licence.
  • AML/CTF law requires it for business services. Since 1 July 2026, accountants who set up companies and trusts, register businesses or handle client money are regulated by AUSTRAC. We run a full AML/CTF program and apply the same standard to every client, not only those the law captures.
  • One standard, no exceptions. Because the check is universal, there is nothing to be offended by and no judgement call about who looks risky. Everyone does it, including the people who have been with us for years.

What the check involves

  1. 01 A secure link arrives by SMS or email the moment you sign up in the client portal or accept a quote.
  2. 02 You photograph one government photo ID with your phone camera — driver licence or passport.
  3. 03 A short selfie confirms the person holding the document is the person on it.
  4. 04 The document is checked against the issuing authority’s records through the government Document Verification Service.
  5. 05 Your name is screened against sanctions and politically-exposed-person lists, as AML/CTF law requires. The result reaches us in seconds and your file is opened.

What to have ready

One current Australian driver licence or passport is enough for most people. If you hold neither, an Australian photo card, an ImmiCard or a foreign passport also work, and we may ask for a second document such as a Medicare card to confirm the match. Expats and non-residents can complete the check from anywhere with a passport and a phone.

Companies, trusts and SMSFs

When the client is an entity we verify the people behind it: each director, each trustee, and anyone who owns or controls 25% or more of it. Each person receives their own link and completes their own check. We also confirm the entity itself against the ASIC and ABN registers. This is the beneficial-ownership requirement under AML/CTF law and it is why a company setup needs every director verified before we lodge with ASIC.

What happens to your data

Your document images, selfie and the verification result are captured and held by our identity verification provider, not emailed to us and not stored on this website. We see the outcome and the verified details, which go onto your client record in our portal. AML/CTF law requires us to keep verification records for seven years after our relationship with you ends, after which they are destroyed. The images are used only to verify you and are never used for marketing or shared with anyone other than regulators where the law requires it. Our privacy policy sets out the detail.

If the check doesn’t pass

Usually it is a worn licence, a changed name, or a photo taken in bad light. We will ask you to try again with a different document or send a certified copy instead. If identity cannot be established at all, we cannot act — that is the rule working as intended, and we would rather turn away a client than lodge for someone we cannot verify.

Common questions

Why do I need to verify my ID for a simple tax return?
Because a tax return is exactly what identity thieves lodge. Once a return is lodged in your name, your refund, your bank details and your prior-year data are exposed. Three minutes up front is cheap insurance, and the TPB requires us to verify you anyway.

I’m an existing client. Do I have to do it again?
Once. We are bringing every client onto the same electronic standard, so you will receive a link the next time we start work for you. After that, only if your details change or the law requires a refresh.

Is my ID data safe?
It is held by an ISO 27001-certified Australian platform built for this purpose, never as an email attachment and never on this website. We see the result, not a folder of licence photos.

Does this slow down my return?
No. The check runs while you fill in the intake form, and the result arrives in seconds. The old way — posting certified copies or booking a visit to show a licence — is what used to slow things down.

Ready when you are

Create your portal account and the verification link follows. Nothing is charged until your return is lodged.
